content_data.meeting_title: Warehouse Management System API Integration Sprint Planning
agenda_items: Plan API versioning strategy for legacy client compatibility
Review current integration architecture for third-party logistics providers
Discuss database schema changes for real-time shipment tracking
key_decisions: Adopt GraphQL for new carrier integration endpoints to reduce API calls by 40%
Implement Redis caching layer for frequently accessed shipment status queries
Standardize on OpenAPI 3.0 specification for all external-facing APIs
Postpone MongoDB migration until after current sprint to avoid blocking production releases
